regime_context: As of 2026-07-17, the thematic momentum detector shows a broad rotation (70% eligible) with Memory & HBM leading but fading, and Cybersecurity surging as a durable, high-breadth challenger. Crowding is elevated in several healthcare and semiconductor themes. No single narrative dominates; the absolute-trend gate filters ineligible themes lacking staying power. With zero track record, all leans are low-confidence.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the strongest trending eligible theme: rank #2 with near-perfect breadth (1.0), high durability (0.90), and a clear trend tag. It passes the absolute-trend gate, the only validated risk-control edge. The crowding flag is a sizing caution, not a fade call. This is a risk-managed relative overweight, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding z-score of +2.2 is high; historically, elevated positioning can lead to sharp reversals even in strong trenders. The momentum rank has no forward return edge, so leadership may not persist.

falsifier.text: Cybersecurity ETF CIBR underperforms the S&P 500 by >2% over the next 20 trading days, or its detector rank falls below 5 and breadth drops below 0.7.

theses.subject: Financials (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Financials EW is a moderate-ranking eligible theme (rank #8) that passes the trend gate with high durability (0.83) and breadth (0.895), and is not crowded. It offers a non-crowded, trend-following equity theme while many leaders are crowded. Confidence is low given the weak alpha of momentum ranks.
theses.dissent: Financials momentum is not top-tier; if the market rotates back to AI/semiconductor themes or if yield-curve dynamics shift, this sector could underperform. The gate only controls risk, not upside.

falsifier.text: Financials ETF XLF underperforms S&P 500 by >3% over the next 30 trading days, or its detector eligibility flips to false.

theses.subject: Crypto & Digital Assets
theses.thesis: Crypto & Digital Assets theme (rank #43) is ineligible, failing the absolute-trend gate—the only validated edge for drawdown control. It shows mixed/mean-revert characteristics, low durability (0.22), and zero breadth. This justifies an underweight as risk avoidance, not a return call.
evidence: gate_helps=true – ineligible themes historically suffer larger drawdowns
theses.dissent: Crypto can serve as a risk-on proxy during re-acceleration in AI/tech narratives, and macro surprises (e.g., dovish shift) could spark a rally. The underweight is purely a risk-management posture, not a directional fade.

falsifier.text: IBIT outperforms the S&P 500 by >5% over the next 20 trading days, or its detector eligibility flips to true with durability_bar > 0.5.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
